messages:
Maya Lien: Heads up — we got a customer report that their quota was exhausted overnight but our usage dashboard only shows ~40% of the billed tokens. Suspect double counting from retries/tool calls.
Samir Patel: Can you paste the logs? which customer/org id?
Maya Lien: org_id=org_9zX, local logs attached snippet: 
```
INFO request_id=abc123 prompt_tokens=420 completion_tokens=120 tool_calls=[{name:"file_search", prompt_tokens:30, completion_tokens:10}] retries=1
INFO request_id=abc123 retry_of=abc122 prompt_tokens=420 completion_tokens=120 tool_calls=[]
```
It looks like the retry entry is being billed separately in telemetry and also the tool_call tokens are being added twice. :/
Oliver Chen: Hmm, that log shows retries with same prompt size and same completion size. Our ingestion pipeline currently sums over all request records keyed by timestamp, not by idempotency key. So retries will get added unless we dedupe by `retry_of` or `idempotency_key`.
Rachel (quota-bot): Alert: org_9zX exceeded soft quota at 2026-03-17T23:12:14Z — policy: per-org-monthly. Triggered billing webhook.
Samir Patel: We already have idempotency keys for hosted API, but some SDK calls don't set them and the proxy generates a fallback id. That fallback differs across retry attempts, so dedupe fails.
Maya Lien: The twist: tool calls (like calling a search tool) return their own token counts and we currently add tool_tokens to completion_tokens in two places: runtime emits completion_tokens including tool consumption, and the proxy also sums tool_calls[].completion_tokens when building telemetry. That doubles tool consumption.
Oliver Chen: Proposed quick fix: change telemetry ingestion to prefer runtime-provided `completion_tokens` and ignore tool_calls[].completion_tokens if runtime has tool-inclusive total. Add a conservative flag `tool_tokens_explicit:true|false` in the event schema.
Samir Patel: Agreed but need backward compatibility — old events may lack the flag. Suggest logic: if event.tool_calls exists && runtime_completion >= sum(tool_calls.completion_tokens) then treat runtime_completion as authoritative and drop per-tool counts from billing. Else fallback to sum.
Tony (deploy-bot): FYI canary rollout ready on prod-inference-4, will take 5% traffic for 2 hours once code landed.
Maya Lien: Also need to fix rate-limiter accounting: burst credits are consumed on initial attempt and not restored on retry, so retries can cause perceptible bursts. Maybe only charge burst tokens on final successful request?
Oliver Chen: That would help user experience but could be gamed. Alternative: charge provisional burst reservation but refund when we see an idempotent-success marker, with a refund window of 30s to avoid lingering uncommitted states.
Samir Patel: Implementation steps I'm thinking: 1) add `idempotency_key` unify in proxy (if absent generate stable hash from user+body) 2) update ingestion to dedupe by idempotency_key for N seconds (configurable) 3) change telemetry merge logic to prefer runtime_total unless explicit flag indicates split accounting 4) add refund path for burst credits when retries deduped.
Maya Lien: Can we also add a diagnostic metric to the console: `tokens_counted_vs_billed_ratio` per-org and `retries_double_count_rate`? Need to show cases where logged tokens != billing tokens.
Samir Patel: Yes. We'll add a dashboard panel and an alert when ratio >1.05 for >10m.
Oliver Chen: Quick note on rollout: do ingestion change behind feature flag `telemetry.v2_token_merge`. Start with a staging run of 24h, then canary 5%, then 100% after no regressions. Also add an opt-in flag for enterprise customers to keep legacy accounting for audit trails.
Maya Lien: Who will own the telemetry code change? @Samir or @Oliver?
Samir Patel: I'll take the ingestion dedupe + merge logic. Oliver take proxy idempotency generation and refund flow. Maya can you add the dashboard and coordinate with billing?
Maya Lien: Yep, will create the console PR and ping billing for an audit.
Rachel (quota-bot): Note: billing system will need a backfill script if we find customers were overbilled historically. That is a separate ops runbook.
Tony (deploy-bot): Deploy checklist: unit tests for dedupe, e2e with simulated retry loop, load test with tool-heavy calls, feature flag toggle.
Samir Patel: I'll open the GH issues and link here. Initial patch ETA: 3 days for ingestion, 5 days for proxy changes.
Maya Lien: Thanks — let's track in eng-platform board. :thumbsup:
